events.name: Creepy Crawler Hike
events.place: Big Bend of the Colorado State Recreation Area, North Trail Loop
events.note: State park entry fee may apply.
events.description: Join a ranger at Big Bend of the Colorado State Recreation Area for a creepy crawler adventure through the North Trail Loop.

events.name: Willow Beach Cleanup (Leave No Trace Spotlight)
events.place: Willow Beach, Lake Mead NRA (AZ side)
events.description: Part of Leave No Trace's Spotlight visit to Lake Mead National Recreation Area Oct 29–31. Volunteers help clean up Willow Beach; the meeting location and a password for free entry are sent after you sign up.

events.name: Falling Leaves Craft
events.description: Create a door or wall hanging using cardboard and old books. Adults, teens and tweens are welcome.

events.name: 28th Annual CRWC Boom Box Parade
events.place: River Gardens Dr & Hancock Rd to Alona Way, Bullhead City
events.description: Bullhead City's holiday parade, themed American Christmas this year, with decorated floats and vehicles from local businesses, schools, nonprofits and first responders. Bring chairs; the route runs from River Gardens Dr & Hancock Rd to Alona Way.

events.name: Holly Jolly Holiday Bazaar
events.place: Anderson Auto Group Fieldhouse, Bullhead City
events.note: Hours listed in Arizona time; confirm with the organizer.
events.description: A holiday bazaar at the Anderson Auto Group Fieldhouse across the river in Bullhead City, listed by the Laughlin Chamber.

events.name: Nik at Nite – A Jazzy Holiday Concert
events.description: Nik sings classic holiday songs in a Sinatra-style sing-along. Free and open to the public; seating is first come, first served.

events.name: Light the Belle
events.place: Bullhead Belle, Community Park, Bullhead City
events.description: Thousands of holiday lights switch on at the Bullhead Belle on the Colorado River at sundown. The lights stay up through the holiday season for photos and evening strolls.

events.name: Graham Cracker Cottages
events.description: Kids build holiday houses out of graham crackers, candy and frosting. Ages 0–17 welcome; free while supplies last.

events.name: Christmas on the Colorado Lighted Boat Parade
events.place: Colorado River (watch from the Laughlin Riverwalk or Bullhead City Community Park)
events.description: Decorated boats light up the Colorado River at sunset. Watch from anywhere along the river, or from the Bullhead Belle.

events.name: Desert Artisan Exchange
events.place: Aquarius Casino Resort, 1900 S Casino Dr, Laughlin
events.description: A seasonal art and craft market with 40–90 curated artists, makers and designers. This December weekend is the first of five monthly market weekends running through April 2027.
